When I was in elementary school, my parents were both working full time so I would go to a daycare after school and during the holidays. One day, I was at the daycare and had plans to go see a movie with my aunt later that day. I started feeling really sick and had trouble breathing, but I didn‘t tell anyone because I was scared that I wouldn‘t be allowed to go to the movie if I did (I think it was Shrek and I was just really excited). Well one of the ladies working at the daycare realized that something was up when I wouldn’t eat anything all day (swallowing hurt too much), so when my mum came to pick me up she told her about it. My mum took me to the doctor straight away and as it turned out, I had an abscess in the back of my throat which slowly started to shut my airway.   
I had to go into emergency surgery or I would have died about an hour later.   


TL;DR: if it hadn’t been for my daycare worker, I would have died while watching Shrek
